# Security Policy

We take security seriously. Please do **not** disclose security vulnerabilities in
public GitHub issues, discussions, or pull requests — report them privately so we
can fix the issue and coordinate disclosure with you before it is public.

## Supported Versions

We provide security fixes for the latest major release.

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 2.x     | ✅         |
| 1.x     | ❌         |

Users on an older major version should upgrade to the latest patch of the
supported release.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within Laravel imgproxy, email
[abc.imams@gmail.com](mailto:abc.imams@gmail.com) with as much of the following
as you can provide:

- The package version(s) affected.
- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept.
- Any suggested fix or mitigation.

We aim to acknowledge reports within **3 business days** and will keep you
updated as we investigate. Once a fix is prepared, we coordinate public
disclosure with you before releasing it to avoid putting users at risk.
